clips.context: Top of the eighth: Cruz starts and stops on an 0–2 slider from Joe Jiménez. Gibson awards hit by pitch, and Detroit’s challenge is unsuccessful. The final HBP ruling means no swing; a separate base-umpire appeal is not established.

review.notes: Provisional primary assessment: continuous first-base-side replay begins in loaded stance, then hands/barrel start forward, brake in front of torso, and reverse/return with no full followthrough. Proposed 21.65–24.55 avoids initial dissolve and ends before cut back to pitcher/decision. Source live sequence shows plate umpire awarding first around4.0–4.8; feed identifies Tripp Gibson. Do not infer a separate base appeal from the pitcher asking for one. Needs another independent reviewer to confirm actual onset versus protective movement and complete result-free window before publication.

ownDense.note: Initial dissolve deliberately included to check boundary; proposed start21.65 follows it. Labels are relative to source21.4.

ownOnset.note: Four original-resolution samples verify loaded rear bat, forward hands, and braking/withdrawal.

visualAssessment.reason: Continuous first-base-side replay contains the ready/loaded stance before forward initiation. Hands advance and descend while the barrel rotates away from its loaded angle; motion brakes and retracts with the bat kept in front of the upper body rather than continuing around into a full follow-through. This is a small but visible checked swing with a protective recoil as well, not pure static avoidance. Source21.65–24.55 includes its onset and arrested result without the later HBP decision.
